findings.evidence: Mathlib's adjacent API opens `namespace Base` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Base.lean:80` and defines `IsPos`, `isPos_iff`, `IsPos.neg_iff_not`, and `isPos_of_mem_support` there at lines 476–500; the naming guide reserves dots for namespaces and useful projection notation.
findings.fix: Place the declarations in `namespace RootPairing.Base`, make the definitions take `(b : P.Base)`, and expose them through `b.posRoots`, `b.negRoots`, and the corresponding namespaced lemmas.
findings.issue: All introduced declarations (`posRoots`, `negRoots`, and lines 50–132) concern a `RootPairing.Base` but pollute the top-level namespace and require the redundant spelling `posRoots P b`.

summary: The new base-relative API is placed in the top-level `TauCeti` namespace instead of the existing `RootPairing.Base` namespace.
